An '''Ultra-frequency laserwave link''' was installed on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the [[Mission to Monastery]]. This allowed [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to connect himself to the device and communicate with [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on the planet below, as well as listen in on anything picked up by R2-D2's [[Audio sensor/Legends|audio sensors]].<ref name="MSW35" />
